entities.summary: Kurima Island  is one of the Miyako Islands of Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. It is connected to the southeastern end of the Yonaha Maehama beach on the Miyako-jima island via 1,690 metres Kurima Bridge (来間大橋), which was opened on 13 March 1995.
